summary: Error screen and onboarding, the small follow-ups in two commits: a crash screen that stopped with nobody signed in says someone has signed in since; the reason a report panel closed is kept in the past tense; the form's limits, the name's included, are counted and named as the server counts them (bytes); a superseded onboarding build stops after its own write; the failure's sentence and its button are judged together from the live state. Two passes by an independent reviewer: fix-first (after a late landing the sentence said saved and offered Try again while the only button was Back to your details), then lows-only on this commit (it ran the three test files and the mutation): an older race where an age changed in the details while a first write is still out is refused on every Try again, and a capture note whose condition is narrower than what happens. Both are recorded as known items.
